about.heading: The Blue World Initiative
about.para1: The Blue World Initiative is a transformative program by GoGMI in partnership with DOTCAN (Development of Ocean Technical Capacity for African Nations), dedicated to inspiring the next generation of ocean leaders and blue economy champions across the Gulf of Guinea.
about.para2: Through interactive career fairs, educational resources, and hands-on experiences, we empower young Africans to explore exciting maritime careers while understanding their crucial role in protecting our ocean and building a sustainable blue economy.

dotcan.heading: Partnership with DOTCAN
dotcan.subheading: Development of Ocean Technical Capacity for African Nations
dotcan.para1: DOTCAN is committed to building ocean technical capacity across African nations through innovative educational programs, research initiatives, and capacity-building workshops.
dotcan.para2: Through this strategic partnership, GoGMI and DOTCAN combine expertise in maritime research, policy development, and youth education to create transformative learning experiences that inspire the next generation of ocean leaders.
dotcan.para3: Together, we are building a sustainable blue economy across the Gulf of Guinea region through education, innovation, and collaboration.

careerFair.heading: Ocean Career Fair 2023
careerFair.para1: The Gulf of Guinea Maritime Institute (GoGMI) in partnership with the Development of Technical Capacity for African Nations (DOTCAN) organized a transformative one-day event that brought together students from junior high and secondary schools to interact with key maritime stakeholders.
careerFair.para2: Through engaging presentations and interactive sessions, students discovered the diverse career opportunities in the maritime sector and learned how they can contribute to ocean conservation and sustainable development.

concepts.heading: Key Ocean Concepts
concepts.subtitle: Understanding these fundamental concepts is essential for anyone interested in ocean-related careers and the blue economy.

items.title: Ocean
items.description: The vast body of saltwater that covers over 70% of the Earth's surface.

items.title: Ocean Economy
items.description: The sum total of economic activities that take place in and around the ocean, including fishing, shipping, tourism, and energy production.

items.title: Blue Economy
items.description: The sustainable use of ocean resources for economic growth, job creation, and environmental preservation.

items.title: Sustainability
items.description: The practice of using resources in a way that does not deplete or damage them for future generations.

items.title: Marine Conservation
items.description: The protection and preservation of ocean ecosystems and biodiversity.

items.title: Renewable Energy
items.description: Energy that is generated from sources that are replenished naturally, such as wind, solar, and wave power.

items.title: Aquaculture
items.description: The farming of aquatic organisms such as fish, shellfish, and seaweed.

careers.heading: Ocean-Related Career Pathways
careers.subtitle: Discover exciting career opportunities in the blue economy and maritime sector.

funFact.heading: Fun Fact About Blue Careers
funFact.para1: Did you know that you can play a crucial role in safeguarding the ocean even if you do not wish to work in the careers listed above?
funFact.para2: Accountants and economists can contribute to initiatives on accounting for the Ocean Economy. Doctors, lab technicians and other categories of scientists can learn more about how the release of toxins into the ocean affect human health. Even psychologists can explore the factors that affect the willingness of individuals to adopt sustainable behaviours that safeguard the ocean and its resources. In almost all career fields, you can carve a unique niche for yourself by specialising in a branch of that career that supports the blue economy!

comic.heading: MAN: The Adventures of Maritime Domain Awareness
comic.para1: Engage young minds through exciting storytelling! Our educational comic book series brings maritime concepts to life through the adventures of MAN and his team as they protect the ocean and promote maritime domain awareness.
comic.para2: Through vibrant illustrations and compelling narratives, students learn about ocean conservation, maritime security, and the importance of protecting our blue planet – all while being entertained by action-packed adventures.
